items.description: Electrician labour checking and rewiring flooded circuits, 12 hrs
items.rationale: Surface-water inundation falls under c2 further natural hazards, which the schedule is not shown to record. Under 3.6.1/3.6.2(b) the bar applies to the whole claim, including all labour.
3.6.2(f) excludes every journey charge where the inundation bar applies. If indemnified, this would be the single journey charge at about 79.
Inundation bar applies. In any case this is working equipment, not separately indemnified under 4.3(d), 5.2.2 and 7.1.8(b).
Inundation bar applies. Working equipment is excluded anyway under 4.3(d) and 5.2.2.
This is a measure barred by 3.6.2(d) because the c2 inundation peril is not recorded. Otherwise it would be indemnifiable as a measure.
Materials are barred by 3.6.2(c) for an uninsured inundation.

items.description: Renew boiler incl. flue and storage tank
items.rationale: Replacement of building plant is barred by 3.6.2(a). The flood is not escape of water, and the c2 group is not recorded.

items.description: Adjust supply pipework to replacement boiler
items.rationale: Adaptation work belonging to the replacement is barred by 3.6.2(a).
Removal and disposal are barred by 3.6.2(e).
Every journey charge is barred by 3.6.2(f). Even if the claim were covered, this is the second journey charge and is excluded by 7.1.8(d).
